subject: Control harmonization questions for ISO 27001 & FedRAMP scoping
messages:
From: Sam Hendrix <sam.hendrix@auditfirm.com>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: security@acme.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Clarifying questions: control harmonization for ISO27001 & FedRAMP

Hi Grace,

Thanks for sending the initial materials last week. Before we lock the audit scope I have a short list of clarifying questions so we can determine evidence sampling and the control mapping strategy. Please feel free to route to owners if easier.

1) Control mapping: do you have a single canonical control matrix that maps ISO 27001 controls to FedRAMP control families and SIG/CAIQ artifacts? If so, which version should we use for scoping?
2) Boundary & isolation: for Dedicated and Private deployments, what is the explicit service boundary (VPC vs. managed hosting)? We need a diagram and the list of systems in-scope for encryption-at-rest and key management.
3) Key management: do you use a cloud KMS (customer-managed) or HSM? Who is the control owner for KMS attestations and key rotation logs?
4) Logging & retention: what is your snapshot and audit log retention policy for activity related to model inference (KV cache, prompt logs, system snapshots)? Export sample logs or a sample retention policy would help.
5) Evidence sampling: for control families with continuous evidence (e.g., access reviews), what cadence is in place (monthly/quarterly)? Who performs the reviews?
6) SIG/CAIQ: do you have an up-to-date CAIQ/SIG response draft that we can review for third-party questionnaires?
7) Timeline: are there blackout windows or product launch periods between Aug 1–Sept 15 that would affect evidence collection?

If you can attach the control matrix and the most recent CAIQ/SIG draft that will speed our intake. We can schedule a 30-minute call Thursday to go through owners and an evidence pull plan.

Regards,
Sam Hendrix
Senior IT Audit Manager
AuditFirm Inc.

Attachments: initial_questionnaire.pdf (stub)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Sam Hendrix <sam.hendrix@auditfirm.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarifying questions: control harmonization for ISO27001 & FedRAMP

Hi Sam — thanks, good set of questions. Quick answers and next steps below; I've routed specific asks to owners in the thread.

1) Canonical mapping: yes — we maintain a consolidated control matrix that maps ISO 27001 controls to FedRAMP families and SIG/CAIQ artifacts. Attaching "evidence_map_v1.xlsx" which is the current working file (version 1.2). Use that as the baseline; we'll flag updates during intake.

2) Boundary & isolation: our Private (VPC) deployment is the in-scope boundary for regulated workloads. "control_boundary_diagram.png" shows the high-level VPC, bastion, model-serving pool, and logging pipeline. For Dedicated we have logical isolation with tenant-level KV cache segregation.

3) Key management: we use cloud KMS for host-managed workloads and offer HSM-backed customer-managed keys for Private deployments. Aditya (cc'd) owns KMS attestations and will provide rotation logs and the key custody policy.

4) Logging & retention: retention policy is defined in the "Retention" tab of the attached spreadsheet — standard inference telemetry retained 90 days; admin and audit logs retained 3 years. Priyom (cc'd) will pull a small sample of filtered logs for the past 30 days (redacting PII and model payloads per policy) and share a sanitized export.

5) Evidence sampling cadence: access reviews are quarterly; exception logs are reviewed monthly. The evidence_map file includes owner and cadence columns.

6) SIG/CAIQ: attaching "sig_caiq_mapping.csv" — it's a living draft but has answers for the majority of CAIQ questions; we can complete items you flag.

7) Timeline/blockers: product has a planned feature freeze Aug 10–24 but evidence access is unaffected. We prefer to avoid heavy snapshot exports during Aug 12–14 due to maintenance windows.

Next steps:
- Aditya to provide KMS rotation logs by Fri (24 Jul).
- Priyom to share sanitized log samples by Mon (27 Jul).
- Marissa will coordinate evidence owners for network diagrams and change control records.
- Sam/AuditFirm to confirm a 30-minute slot Thursday 24 Jul between 09:00–12:00 PT; we can use this to finalize sampling and owners.

I attached the three items noted above and a short owner list in the spreadsheet. If anything else is useful ahead of the call, let me know.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Compliance | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sam Hendrix <sam.hendrix@auditfirm.com>, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarifying questions: control harmonization for ISO27001 & FedRAMP

Adding a couple of operational clarifications:
- Control 6.2 (crypto & KMS attestations) is owned by Aditya — he will provide a CSV of rotation events and a short narrative describing HSM usage for Private deployments.
- Change control artifacts (Jira change exports) are stored in the compliance archive; I will export a 3-month slice for your sampling.
- We should plan for selective snapshots rather than full DB dumps; that minimizes maintenance impact.

I'll prepare the Jira export and a short readme for the control matrix consumers; ETA end of day Friday (24 Jul).

Marissa Cole
Director, Security Programs | Redwood Inference

From: Sam Hendrix <sam.hendrix@auditfirm.com>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com, security@acme.com
Date: Wed, 23 Jul 2025 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarifying questions: control harmonization for ISO27001 & FedRAMP

Thanks all — that is helpful and matches what we expected. Confirming the Thursday 24 Jul call at 10:00 AM PT (I've sent a calendar invite). Please bring owners for KMS, logging, and change control.

Action items for audit intake after the call:
- Provide the canonical control matrix PDF and the latest CAIQ draft (we'll use these to generate a sampling list).
- Secure a sanitized export of audit logs and one example of a rotation event for KMS (Aditya).
- Provide a short narrative describing the Private deployment boundary and where customer-managed keys are used.

Portal intake: I've opened an intake ticket and uploaded our questionnaire copy to: https://portal.auditfirm.com/intake/73821 — you can upload artifacts there if that is easier for your team.

If the maintenance window conflicts with any of the evidence pulls, we can schedule around it. See you on the call.

Best,
Sam
Senior IT Audit Manager
AuditFirm Inc.
